intro: The D'Laze is the diode laser platform for laser hair reduction at Skin Essence in Ahmedabad. Diode lasers are the workhorse of hair reduction because their near-infrared light is absorbed by the pigment in the hair shaft and follicle, heating and disabling the follicle while a cooled handpiece protects the skin surface.

As with every laser at Skin Essence, the parameters are set by a dermatologist for the patient's skin tone, hair thickness and the area being treated, and tanned skin is treated only once the tan has faded.
whatItTreats: For women: full body, face, underarms, arms, legs and bikini
For men: beard shaping, eyebrow shaping, ears, chest and shoulders
Ingrown hairs and razor bumps from repeated shaving or waxing

howItWorks.title: Selective absorption
howItWorks.description: The diode laser's light is absorbed by the melanin in the hair, heating the follicle to the point where it stops producing hair, while the surrounding skin absorbs far less energy.

howItWorks.title: Cooled handpiece
howItWorks.description: The contact-cooled tip keeps the skin surface cold during each pulse, so the session is comfortable and the surface is protected.

howItWorks.title: A course of sessions
howItWorks.description: Hair grows in cycles, so 6 to 8 sessions spaced 4 to 8 weeks apart are needed to catch each follicle in its growth phase.

faqs.q: Is diode laser hair reduction safe for Indian skin?
faqs.a: Yes, with settings chosen for the skin type by a dermatologist and with the skin untanned at the time of treatment. Burns and pigment changes come from wrong settings or untrained operators, not from the technology itself.

faqs.q: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.a: Typically 6 to 8 sessions. Coarse dark hair responds fastest; fine or hormonal hair may need more sessions and occasional maintenance.
